# Flarewise

> Crohn's-friendly food catalog as a static GitHub Pages PWA.

Flarewise helps people browse flare-aware foods, recipes, and takeout mods.
It is open source and not medical advice.

This project welcomes agents. Please use the data — and add to it when you can.

## For AI agents

- Machine-readable catalog: /catalog.json (includes embedded `rubric`)
- Scoring rubric (SoT): /rubric.json — also `catalog.rubric`; do not hardcode bands elsewhere
- JSON Schema for food items: /schema.json
- Build metadata: /build-info.json
- Human docs: /README.md
- Contributor / maintainers: /CONTRIBUTING.md
- Source item files: src/data/items/<category>/<id>.json (one file per food)
- In-app submit: /#/submit (opens a GitHub Issue with a fenced ```json block)
- Per-food share / unfurl pages: /f/{id}/ (OG tags; redirects into /#/?item={id})
- Site Open Graph image: /og.png
- Maintainer ingestion: apply label `approved-food` to create a PR
- Job predicates (Make / Order / Check): `src/lib/filters.ts`

## How to add a food

1. Validate against /schema.json (or src/data/schema.json).
2. Prefer opening a GitHub Issue with label `new-food` and a ```json payload.
3. Or add `src/data/items/<categoryFolder>/<id>.json` directly and open a PR.
4. Run `npm run validate-data` before merge.
5. Set tags / mealTypes / prepMethod so catalog jobs classify correctly (below).

## Key product rules

- Today dial = how the user feels (bad → good). It filters the list.
- UI tiers (not raw scores in the main list): Flare safe, Everyday, Careful/Good-day fit, Avoid.
- Underlying crohnsScore remains 1–10 where higher is gentler for sorting/filtering.
- Avoid/danger-zone items stay hidden unless explicitly enabled.
- Front scopes are **Make / Order / Check** (URL `job`), not Everyday/Parks/Cruise.
- **Make** = cook/prep at home: home prep methods (`stovetop`, `skillet`, `slow-cooker`, `toaster-oven`) or non-empty `groceryIngredients`, and **not** an Order item.
- **Order** = restaurant / takeout / drive-thru: `mealTypes` includes `takeout`, `prepMethod` includes `drive-thru`, or tags in `restaurant` / `takeout` / `drive-thru` / `fast-food`. Brand alone does **not** make an item Order.
- **Check** = catch-all staples / ingredients / “can I eat X?” — not Order and not Make.
- Vacation (theme parks & cruises) is **Filters only** (`place=home|theme-parks|cruise`); default off. While vacation browsing is on, job chips are ignored so menus stay intact.
- Vacation items stay hidden by default. Every vacation food MUST include `"vacation"` (or `"disney-cruise"` / `"cruise"`) in `tags`, plus destination tags (`"disneyland"`, `"california-adventure"`, `"knotts-berry-farm"`, `"disney-wonder"`, `"disney-magic"`, `"disney-treasure"`) when applicable.
- Citrus guardrail: `citrusFree: false` whenever lemon, lime, orange, grapefruit (score `1.0` hard avoid), yuzu/ponzu, or bergamot/Earl Grey is present.
- Lactose rule: naturally aged cheeses (Cheddar, Swiss, Gruyère, Havarti, Provolone, Parmigiano-Reggiano, Manchego) are `lactoseSafe: true`; unaged dairy/cream/ice cream is `lactoseSafe: false`.
- Preferences (stars, grocery, personal status, dial, guardrails, theme) are localStorage; optional user-driven secret GitHub Gist sync. Never commit personal prefs or tokens.

## Scoring rubric (for agents)

Canonical machine rubric: `/rubric.json` (same object as `catalog.rubric`; source `src/data/rubric.json`).
Use `agentBrief` + `bands` / `dial` from that file when ranking or drafting — do not invent vibes or mirror the numbers in other repos.
Today dial maps feeling → min crohnsScore floor. For catalog growth or an unspecified/steady+ dial, suggest Everyday and Careful too — not only Flare safe. Keep user-facing replies short; do not repeat a medical-disclaimer boilerplate every turn.

## Honoring Make / Order / Check when drafting foods

When suggesting or adding an item, choose fields so the predicates stay true:

| Intent | Set these |
|--------|-----------|
| Home recipe / meal prep | prepMethod with home methods and/or groceryIngredients; avoid restaurant/takeout/drive-thru tags |
| Restaurant / takeout / venue dish | tag `restaurant` (and/or takeout / drive-thru / fast-food); use mealType `takeout` or prep `drive-thru` when accurate; set `brandOrRestaurant` for venue menus |
| Staple / ingredient / packaged “is this OK?” | ready-to-eat or minimal prep; no Order tags; usually no home-prep grocery list — lands in Check |

Do not invent a fourth front scope. Do not put parks/cruise on the front row — vacation tags + Filters only.
